segments.text: Let's talk about pain while pooping. I have endometriosis [music] and for the last 7 years I've been dealing with those symptoms before I got my official diagnosis. One of my most significant symptoms that's kind of classic with endo [music] is I'll have pain while defecating. So my first pain that I was experiencing that was really severe was probably in 2018, [music] 2019. One time I was in Hawaii on vacation and I would went to use the restroom [music] and I thought I was going to pass out in this public restroom. I was in so much pain that I was worried that it was like a

life-threatening condition. I went to the doctor cuz I was experiencing these abnormal symptoms, got an ultrasound, she said everything [music] looked fine, and she said, "Based on your symptoms, I suspect that you might have endometriosis." That was the first time I ever heard of it.

When you go to a doctor and they say, you know, [music] you can get surgery to diagnose it. It was a fork in the road and one side was you have to go figure out how to get surgery. know how much it's going to cost. I don't know how invasive. I don't even know like what it entailed. And I also hoped that it would just go away [music] with time. And so I just didn't think about it again after that and years went by and every period [music] just kind of got worse and worse and that just became normal life.
